question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open My Orders in the app or on bazaarnow.in and tap the order to see live tracking. You also get SMS and email updates at every step.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Most orders arrive in 2-5 business days in metro cities and 4-8 business days elsewhere. The exact date is shown at checkout.

question: Do you deliver on Sundays?
answer: Yes, we deliver on Sundays in metro cities. In other areas, Sunday delivery depends on the courier partner.

question: What are the delivery charges?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499. Below that, a Rs 40 delivery fee applies.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to Rs 10,000 at most pincodes. Checkout shows if COD is available for yours.

question: Is there an extra fee for Cash on Delivery?
answer: Yes, a Rs 20 handling fee applies to Cash on Delivery orders. Prepaid orders have no extra fee.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the order and tap Cancel. You can cancel any time before the order is shipped.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing the order?
answer: You can change the address from My Orders until the order is packed. After that, contact support and we will try to help.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 10 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Some items like innerwear and groceries are not returnable.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item and tap Return. Pick a reason and a pickup slot, and our courier will collect it from your address.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 2 days of the returned item reaching our warehouse. It then takes 5-7 business days to show in your account.

question: How will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds go back to the original payment method. For Cash on Delivery orders, the refund goes to your BazaarNow wallet or a bank account you choose.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Yes, clothing and footwear can be exchanged for a different size within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock. Choose Exchange in My Orders.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, BazaarNow wallet, EMI and Cash on Delivery.

question: Is it safe to save my card on BazaarNow?
answer: Yes. Cards are saved as tokens with your bank as per RBI rules; we never store your full card number.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
answer: Don't worry, failed payments are automatically reversed by your bank within 5-7 business days. If not, raise a ticket at help.bazaarnow.in with the transaction date.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter the coupon code in the Apply Coupon box on the cart page before you pay. The discount shows in the order summary.

question: Why is my coupon not working?
answer: A coupon may fail if it has expired, the cart is below the minimum value, or the items are excluded. Check the coupon terms on the offers page.

question: How much does BazaarNow Plus membership cost?
answer: BazaarNow Plus costs Rs 999 per year or Rs 129 per month.

question: What are the benefits of BazaarNow Plus?
answer: Plus members get free delivery on all orders, early access to sales and 5% extra cashback on wallet payments.

question: Do you offer EMI?
answer: Yes, EMI is available on credit cards and select debit cards for orders above Rs 3,000. No-cost EMI is offered on selected products.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Tap Forgot Password on the login screen and enter your registered email or mobile number. We will send a reset link or OTP.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings and choose Delete Account. Deletion is permanent and is completed within 30 days.

question: How do I contact customer care?
answer: Chat with us 24x7 at help.bazaarnow.in or call our toll-free number 1800-202-5050 between 9 am and 9 pm.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: No, we currently deliver only within India.

question: Is there a warranty on electronics?
answer: Electronics carry the brand's manufacturer warranty, usually 1 year. Warranty details are on each product page.

question: Can I get a GST invoice for my order?
answer: Yes. Add your GSTIN at checkout and the GST invoice will be available to download from My Orders.

question: What should I do if I receive a damaged product?
answer: Report it within 48 hours from My Orders with a photo of the item and packaging. We will arrange a free replacement or refund.

question: Can I choose a delivery date?
answer: Yes, for many items you can pick a delivery slot at checkout. Scheduled delivery is free for Plus members.

question: How do I use my BazaarNow wallet balance?
answer: Wallet balance is applied automatically at checkout when you select the wallet. You can combine it with UPI or a card.
